decision.next_action: Do not retrain the same bilateral chart. Diagnose and preregister a task-functional c_proj projection metric, based on post-GELU activation covariance or an equivalent dense-direction surrogate, because Frobenius update recovery does not prevent closed-loop trajectory drift.

interpretation: Making the parent selector production-faithful changes output32 validation CE by only +0.00000763 and right-only by -0.00002289 relative to the previous endpoint oracle, so the prior bilateral endpoint gain was not a weight-decay-selection artifact.

Output32 still improves paired validation CE by 0.02459812 and train CE by 0.02424622 over right-only, leaving only 0.00655937 validation CE to the dense endpoint. Output64 reaches a 0.02640104 validation gain and 0.00475645 dense gap.

The causal output32 run nevertheless worsened validation CE by 0.00110149 versus its causal right-only control. The contradiction localizes the failure to closed-loop trajectory conditioning: bilateral output capacity fits useful dense-teacher directions, but the compressed model does not generate those directions by itself.
The next fix must change the projection metric or supply a task-functional direction surrogate; adding more Frobenius-matched output stages or rerunning the same optimizer is not supported.
